note: Route-JS ceilings (gzip bytes). Set 2026-10-26 from the honest measurement after FIX-E-PERF2 round 2 + ~10 KB headroom. The redesign's original budget (kickoff baseline + 120 KB, SPEC §13.12) is not met honestly: the OSINT + decision-support features and the workspace redesign legitimately add weight on the first screen (map ~95-101 KB, EN strings ~44-48 KB, ops data layer ~34 KB, framework ~38 KB). These ceilings stop regressions; the remaining reductions (per-surface EN strings, ops store split, on-demand map tools, per-route icons, scroll-loaded /ops tiles) are listed in the FIX-E-PERF2 report. Kickoff baseline for reference: / 230084, /ops 249778, /gods-eye 227951.
